title: Exact calibration of structural models via time-change
summary: In this note, we propose a general structural approach to model a default time $τ$ as the first-passage time (FPT) of a (``firm-value'') process $S$ below a (``debt'') barrier $K$ that comply with a pre-specified survival probability curve $G(t)=\Pr(τ>t)$. Following an idea of Mbaye and Vrins (Mathematical Finance, 2022) applied to reduced-form models, our approach consists in two steps: choose a latent FPT model driven by a barrier $\tilde{K}$ and process $\tilde{S}$, and time-change those using a deterministic clock $Θ$ to get $K_t=\tilde{K}_{Θ(t)}$ and $S_t:=\tilde{S}_{Θ(t)}$, leading to…
